designThesis: Watch Ledger: always-on entry line commits passages to dense log; refuse KPI dashboard.
subjectGrounding: Passage Log Console; harbour masters; vessel/direction/time/berth note; form-save-row; desktop; empty/validation/success/offline; Ctrl+Enter; near-black/fog grey/amber-warn; imageless; no fintech gradients/KPIs/logos.
composition: Full-width: status strip; permanent entry band; dense log body.
typography: Neutral UI sans; short labels; tabular times.
colourAndMaterialModel: Near-black shell; fog grey panels; amber warn only.
primaryRisk: Density 8 becomes generic dark CRUD without entry-line discipline.
implementationGuidance: Watch Ledger only; pack states; no KPIs/maps/logos/gradients. Alternates C1 AIS C2 checklist. Seed index0 Bound vessel movement ledger (h2h-passage-2026-07-31). density8 motion1 boldness3.
unknowns: Timestamp default; berth note requiredness; extra fields; multi-user; map/AIS.
